name: Paint

workflows.draw_freehand: Pick the Pencil in the Tools group, then drag on the canvas to draw.
workflows.draw_shape: Pick a shape in the Shapes group (line, rectangle, ellipse, triangle and so on), then drag on the canvas to place it; drag its handles to resize.
workflows.add_text: Pick the Text tool (the A icon) in the Tools group, click the canvas where the text goes, then type in the text box that appears.
workflows.fill_color: Pick the Fill tool (the bucket icon), pick a color in the Colors palette, then click inside an enclosed area.

layout.toolbar: top, under the title bar: tool groups such as Selection, Image, Tools, Brushes, Shapes, Size and Colors
layout.tools_group: Pencil, Fill, Text (A), Eraser, Color picker, Magnifier
layout.shapes_group: Line, Rectangle, Ellipse, Triangle, Arrow, Star and more
layout.colors_palette: color swatches at the right of the toolbar
layout.canvas: the large area under the toolbar where drawing happens
layout.status_bar: bottom: pointer position and canvas size

tips: Microsoft publishes no keyboard-shortcut page for the current Paint app, so only general Windows keys are listed; pick tools by their names in the toolbar.
The canvas is a drawing surface: read it with a screenshot and draw with drags planned from that image.
Choose the tool first (Pencil for freehand, a shape for geometry), then act on the canvas.
The Text tool needs two steps: pick the tool, then click the canvas to place the text box.
ctrl+z undoes the last stroke, so a wrong drag is cheap to take back.
